name: mab-bernoulli
description: Classical MAB: 10 Bernoulli instances with 10 arms (means uniform in [0.05, 0.95], gap >= 0.05), 2 runs each. Theoretical defaults.

notices.title: Default hyperparameters
notices.text: Paper values: alpha=1 for UCB1, UCB1Tuned, UCBV and UCBMinV1; c=3 for KLUCB. Safe in theory, but they often explore too much.
notices.todo: Grid search: param_grid=True. Or set them, e.g. UCB1(alpha=0.1).

notices.title: Not stored
notices.text: Per-action estimates, action of every step, peak memory. The charts cannot show them.

notices.title: One point every 50 steps
notices.text: Between two stored points, the curve is drawn, not measured. You set log_interval=50.

notices.title: Parallel runs
notices.text: Runs in parallel (n_jobs=4), one BLAS thread each.
notices.todo: Compare CPU times only between runs with the same n_jobs.
